rca_of_the_issue.root_cause: React 19 StrictMode double-mounts components, causing bpmn-js modeler to be destroyed during importXML operation. The Canvas was being accessed after destruction, causing 'root-0' error.
rca_of_the_issue.fix_applied: 1) Backend now returns valid BPMN XML fallback when stored XML is invalid (<50 chars or missing 'definitions'). 2) Frontend uses dedicated container div per modeler instance and 'cancelled' flag to prevent operations after unmount. 3) safeImport function catches errors and falls back to DEFAULT_BPMN.
rca_of_the_issue.reproduction_steps: 1) Navigate to /editor/d261a9af-8cfc-44fc-8aa8-417b0e00c60d (diagram with invalid XML). 2) Previously crashed with 'root-0' error. 3) Now loads fallback diagram correctly.
